facts.claim: Bhiwandi Town is the headquarters of the taluka of the same name in Thana District, Bombay.
facts.quote: Bhiwandi Town. — Head-quarters of the tdluka of the same name in Thana District, Bombay, situated in 190 18' N. and 730 3' E., 29 'miles north-east of Bombay.

facts.claim: The population of Bhiwandi in 1901 was 10,354.
The largest steam rice-husking mill in the Presidency is situated in Bhiwandi.
facts.quote: The largest steam rice-husking mill in the Presidency is situated here.
